verdict.rationale: Formant's evidence shows an agent that installs on ROS1/ROS2 devices, ingests configured data streams, and publishes to ROS topics. None of it documents ready-made drivers for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, or standard sensor message types. ROS integration and SDK-based telemetry ingestion are adjacent building blocks, not the requested hardware bring-up capability.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can integrate cameras, lidars, IMUs, and GPS with ready-made drivers and standard message types
